prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of Coin — the lord of the Coin House of the Gold Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Gold (Au) to carry in her design and the scene: warm yellow gold with deep amber shadow, hammered gold leaf and embossed relief, fine stamped borders, permanence shown as an unchanging polish; the element of wealth, permanence and light. Palette: yellow gold, amber, electrum pale, deep red velvet.
HOUSE TRAITS of Coin: round disc shapes, embossed relief (a lion head), fine stamped-edge borders, stacked bars. Palette: yellow gold, amber shadow, electrum pale, dark velvet.
AGE: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs build; voluminous hair with long bangs falling over one eye; polished brass-gold hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a glamorous, sultry allure; fair skin; round face; large eyes — large round eyes, outer eye corners tilting sharply upward; thin arched brows; small button nose; full heart-shaped lips; amber eyes; bold red lipstick.
WORLD — FANTASY: a golden kingdom: a temple of beaten gold, gold-leaf walls, a treasury that glows without lamps, dry sunlit hills. COSTUME (fantasy): a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns. No corset, no bustle, no Victorian tailoring, no modern material, no machinery. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, anime facial design that keeps each character's own facial structure, eye proportions and skin tone instead of one house face, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted, lids lowered in a knowing look, chin tipped slightly up.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Au) and atomic number (79) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
